title: Parcel sorting room
description: A parcel sorting hall: an induction belt and roller lanes, a row of wire dispatch cages, packing tables with computers and scanners, and an exception bench with problem crates.

tasks.text: At the packing workbench with the padded envelope, find the mouse beside the keyboard. Push the mouse 20 cm straight back from the operator’s edge toward the rear of the workbench, keeping it upright.

locatorSteps.label: Push the mouse 20 cm straight back, keeping it upright.

tasks.text: Take the small top box from the crate on the inspection workbench beside the inclined conveyor. Set it on the clear spot in front of the handheld scanner, to the right of the keyboard. Press and release the workbench’s confirmation button, then place the same box on the clear edge of the conveyor’s flat lower end nearest the workbench.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the top box from the inspection crate.
Set it on the clear spot in front of the scanner.
Press and release the confirmation button.
Pick up the same box again.
Set it at the flat lower end, on the edge near the bench.

tasks.text: Counting from the inclined conveyor, open the gate of the cage cart at the third roller chute. Pick up the small box beside the envelope at the end of that chute. Place it on the cart’s raised shelf in the clear front-left spot by the gate, then close the gate.

locatorSteps.label: Open the cage gate at the third roller chute.
Pick up the small box beside the chute-end envelope.
Set it on the raised shelf’s front-left spot.
Close the cage gate.

tasks.text: Find the small upside-down box on the flat lower end of the inclined induction conveyor, beside a bag. Lift the box, turn it over and release it back on that same flat section. Leave it at rest with its label facing up.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the upside-down box at the low end of the belt.
Turn the box label side up.
Release it on the same flat section and let it rest.

tasks.text: Lift the filled plastic mailing bag from the crate on the inspection workbench beside the inclined conveyor. Lay it flat on the same workbench in the clear scanning space in front of the handheld scanner, to the right of the keyboard.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the filled mailing bag out of the crate.
Lay it flat in front of the handheld scanner.

tasks.text: On the packing workbench with the padded envelope, lift the envelope from in front of the scanner rack. Lay it flat near the middle of the same workbench’s front edge, in the clear space between the envelope’s starting spot and the mouse.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the padded envelope in front of the scanner rack.
Lay it flat near the middle of the bench’s front edge.

tasks.text: At the packing workbench with the padded envelope on top, pull the drawer beneath the tabletop 20 cm open. Push it fully closed and let go.

locatorSteps.label: Pull the drawer on the envelope bench out 20 cm.
Push the drawer fully closed and let go.

tasks.text: Find the packing workbench with a small box on top, across the short conveyor from the workbench with the padded envelope. Turn the spool on that bench’s tape dispenser half a turn. Release it and leave the dispenser in place.

locatorSteps.label: Turn the tape spool half a turn.
Release the spool with the dispenser still in place.

tasks.text: Find the cage cart with two boxes on its bottom deck, standing out of line beside the end wall. Roll it 1 m on its castors toward the roller chutes, keeping both boxes aboard. Stop the cart and leave it at rest.

locatorSteps.label: Roll the two-box cart 1 m toward the roller chutes.
Stop the cart and leave both boxes aboard.

tasks.text: At the packing workbench with the padded envelope, lift the handheld scanner from its rack beside the printer. Stand it upright on the same workbench next to the mouse, on the side away from the keyboard. Let go and leave it standing.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the handheld scanner out of its rack.
Stand it by the mouse on the side away from the keyboard.
Release the scanner upright.
